contract.scope: Only admitted local SDK-less import workflow for the three individual profiles; traces are private diagnostic adaptation alongside unchanged native-mapped observations.

schema.traceEvaluation: Internal immutable outcome wrapper containing exactly one of unchanged Result or original IOException/ProfileRejected failure object, plus immutable ordered List<CycleTrace>. Legacy evaluate delegates through the same single execution and returns Result or rethrows the same original object; no successful Result on failure.
cycleTrace: ordered path nodes from root through current owner then closing target
ordered ImportEdge values for every hop, actual defining owner and XML line/column
zero-based cycleStartIndex of closing target within pre-closing ancestry
profile and existing diagnostic index linkage
schema.closedCycle: nodes[cycleStartIndex:] is a closed cycle; ancestry prefix remains available. Self-cycle has two equal endpoints and one edge. Closing target must equal start node. No invented source site at root.
schema.failures: Existing EvaluationFailure constructors/fields, diagnostic values and thrown object type/identity remain unchanged. The trace-aware outcome captures the original IOException/ProfileRejected plus an immutable snapshot of all completed witnesses. REJECT includes current closure once before the original failure; later missing/invalid/XML/admission/item failures retain prior closures without a Result. A failure before State creation has an empty trace. No reevaluation, filesystem reread, wrapper exception or swallowed failure on the legacy route. Fatal VM errors are outside this recoverable diagnostic contract.
schema.occurrence: Exactly one trace per admitted cyclic closing import, in traversal order; flagged warning/error pair shares it. No trace for skipped false edge, nonancestor duplicate, completed diamond or rejected path before cycle classification.
schema.algorithm: Walk actual first-import ancestry from owner; reverse it into root-to-owner edges, locate canonical closing target, append actual closing edge. Compute once per admitted closure; no seen-set-only detection, no global mutable stack/cache, no extra filesystem traversal. Assert linked path/edge invariants.
schema.nativeProjection: No Chain added to Microsoft.Build public types. Native message, code, positions, warning/error order, Import edges, ImportsIncludingDuplicates availability/order, properties and continuation remain unchanged; chain equality is source-adaptation proof only.

profileRules.rule: Root target equality checked first: MSB4210 WARNING ROOT, rootContext=root, previous=null; ignore/continue even REJECT. Trace root-to-owner->root.
Nonroot ancestor closure still MSB4011 WARNING PREVIOUS using exact first-import site; ignore/continue; sidecar reports real cycle without relabeling native context.
Nonroot cycle emits null-code WARNING CIRCULAR, no prior/root context, excludes closing edge from ImportsIncludingDuplicates; continue.
Nonroot cycle emits null-code WARNING then ERROR CIRCULAR and EvaluationFailure before later work; complete trace retained once. Ordinary duplicates stay nonfatal.
Missing import MSB4019, empty expansion MSB4020, false conditions and all existing refusal order retain their prior semantics.

contract.immutability: No Result record component or DuplicateImport change. Preserve six/seven-argument constructors, equals/hashCode/toString, importsIncludingDuplicates null vs empty and immutable item state. Copy nested lists and failure snapshots before publication; no mutable State/DOM/backing builders escape.

bounds.traceCount: No new arbitrary numeric cap: bounded by admitted import elements within existing16x64KiB input envelope; one trace per reached closing import. Do not claim native limit parity.
bounds.aliases: Keep existing inside/relative real-path rules: normalize, sandbox containment, resolved existing ancestor containment, existing file toRealPath; no blanket ban on in-sandbox aliases. Item-glob alias refusals remain separate. Existing filesystem/provider/case limits retained.
bounds.execution: Reuse actual pinned owned-process guard:128MiB JVM heap,2 CPUs,SerialGC,32MiB code cache,120s operation ceiling; Linux180s aggregate with40s reserve, actual resource floor and owned cleanup unchanged. Exact guard hash/argv from inherited driver are authoritative; no arbitrary cap increase.
